messages:
Maya: kickoff — quick sync on Wed webinar ops. need owners for reg page copy, captions, hubspot routing, and who gets the raw recording.
Rory: I can take HubSpot routing + UTM mapping. will post property map. :white_check_mark:
Diego: I'll own Zoom + recording process. need to confirm cloud recording + SRT export enabled.
Samir: I'll do the launch post copy and the 1-min highlight script. want to clip asap for socials.
Kaitlyn: tagging me for registrant nurture: 3-email path (reminder, replay, 7-day nurture). Also want consent checkbox text for clip reuse.
Maya: perfect. consent needs legal-approved wording. can Legal signoff by Tue EOD?
Rory: Legal looped — they asked for exact checkbox text. propose: "I consent to receiving follow-up content and short highlight clips from this event." any concerns?
Diego: Zoom setup notes: enable "Record active speaker with shared screen" + cloud recording to our org folder. enable "Audio transcription" so we get auto captions and SRT. set co-hosts: @Diego + @Samir.
Diego: also set meeting settings: 
```
Auto-recording: On (cloud)
Transcription: On (English)
Participants can join before host: Off
Co-hosts: diego@redwood.com, samir@redwood.com
```
Kaitlyn: for consent we need an explicit opt-in, not prechecked. registry flow: name, email, company, role, timezone, consent checkbox, utm_medium, utm_campaign.
Rory: HubSpot mapping (first pass): 
- email -> contact.email
- name -> contact.firstname + contact.lastname
- company -> company
- role -> persona_segment
- webinar_source (utm_campaign) -> property: webinar_source
- consent -> marketing_consent
I will create a static list and an automation that tags contacts with "webinar:mar-2026".
Maya: post-event deliverables: 1) full recording + SRT, 2) 3 highlight clips (30s, 60s, 2min), 3) transcript + timestamped timestamps for QA, 4) replay landing page + gated form for sales. who owns clips?
Samir: I'll own highlight creation. need editors and clip owners. propose: Samir (script + edit), Maya (priority approval), Kaitlyn (social scheduling).
Kaitlyn: scheduling cadence: publish clip 1 within 24h, clip 2 at 72h, clip 3 one week. also send replay email within 4 hours.
Diego: technical fallback: if cloud recording fails, enable local recording on host. will also run a parallel OBS RTMP to S3 test for backup.
Maya: can you document the fallback steps in runbook? a short checklist we can hand to Greenroom.
Diego: yes, adding to runbook. snippet: 
```
1) Start local recording (Host)
2) Start OBS RTMP -> s3-redwood/webinar-temp
3) After event, download cloud recording ASAP and verify SRT present
4) If missing SRT -> run speech2text pipeline (model: whisper-large-v2) and align timestamps
```
Rory: QA: need 10-second clip test in greenroom to verify SRT timing vs speaker alignment. schedule 15-min greenroom 30m before show.
Samir: re: privacy + clips: Legal suggested a short credit line on replay page: "Event may be recorded; highlights may be used for marketing." add a link to Privacy Policy on reg page.
Maya: who will tag leads for SDRs? Kaitlyn -> handoff list with priority: Hot (attended + engaged), Warm (registered, watched > 20%), Cold (registered, no-show). define thresholds clearly.
Kaitlyn: Hand-off rules: 
- Hot: attended & engaged (chatted or clicked poll) -> create task and assign to regionally mapped SDR
- Warm: attended & passive (>20% watch) -> add to nurture sequence + SDR cadence after 7 days
- Cold: registered only -> add to nurture list, no immediate SDR outreach
Rory: also add a "benchmark feedback" survey in the replay email for people who accepted to run our micro-benchmarks. short form so we can score quality regressions.
Samir: transcripts: I'll run a quick highlight extraction using timestamps and the SRT. prefer automated clip markers at speaker-change + slide change.
Diego: post-event file ownership: Full recording -> storage: marketing/webinars/mar-2026/full.mp4 (Diego), SRT -> marketing/webinars/mar-2026/full.srt (Diego), clips -> marketing/webinars/mar-2026/clips/ (Samir), replay page -> marketing (Maya).
Maya: timeline: event Thu 10am PT. Post-event: raw assets uploaded within 3 hours, clips draft within 24h, first clip live within 36h, replay email within 4h. confirm?
Kaitlyn: confirm. I'll prepare email templates and personalization tokens.
Rory: I'll set up HubSpot workflow and test with staging contact. will send screenshots when done.
ZoomBot: Recording uploaded: https://zoom.us/recording/abc12345 (status: processing)
Diego: thanks bot. I'll check processing and verify SRT when ready.
Maya: Legal signoff expected Tue. Diego, please ensure consent text is visible above CTA on reg page and stored in lead property 'marketing_consent'.
Diego: will update reg page copy in the CMS and ping for review.
Samir: one more ask — can we include a short CTA in the replay for teams to request a live demo? small button that triggers a meeting link.
Maya: yes, add CTA on replay and gate the recorded PDF for those who click. that will improve SQL routing.
Rory: final: I'll run an end-to-end test on Wed greenroom and report back. thanks everyone :rocket:
